title: The Plus+ fund vs stock A
text: Stock A trades at EUR 50 today. In one year it will be worth EUR 62 (expansion) or EUR 48 (recession), each with probability 0.5. No dividends. The risk-free rate is 4%.
The fund Plus+ claims to be better than stock A: for an investment of EUR 100 today it pays EUR 140 in the expansion and EUR 85 in the recession.
